tei:bibl.tei:title: A Prayer of Re-dedication, in the shadow of the Holocaust (CCAR 1951)
tei:bibl.tei:author: Central Conference of American Rabbis [CCAR]
tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: “A Prayer of Re-dedication” (also simply called “Rededication”) is the thirty-fifth prayer in the “Meditations” section of the Union Home Prayer Book (CCAR 1951), p. 199. It is one of only three new prayers found in this section (the others having been reprinted from CCAR’s 1923 collection of teḥinot). A close read of the prayer suggests to me that this prayer was written in the shadow of World War II and the Holocaust, giving voice to concerns over Jewish continuity in the midst of post–World War II economic expansion and largess in the United States. Unfortunately, as with so many of the prayers published as a result of CCAR committees from this period and earlier, we cannot yet attribute this prayer to any known author. (If you know, please leave a comment or contact us.)
